attributes.name: Wine Bottle
attributes.summary:
Track a wine collection one bottle at a time. Each Wine Bottle card answers the two questions a collector actually asks: is it ready to drink, and what is it worth now? A drinking-window marker shows whether the wine is still on hold, at peak, or past it, and the purchase price sits next to the current value with the gain or loss worked out. Producer, varietal, region, vintage, wine type, tasting score, bottles remaining and a label photo complete the record.

Built to work inside a collection-tracking or cellar-inventory app. The isolated view is a full cellar sheet; the embedded row and the four fitted sizes are designed for inventory lists and grids, so a Wine Cellar card can link many bottles and roll them up into totals, average score and a shared drinking-window timeline. Wines with no label photo fall back to a wine-glass illustration — bowl shape by wine type, tinted to the wine's own color — so a part-filled collection still looks deliberate. Colors and fonts are exposed as CSS custom properties for theming.
